description.value: A heritage-listed 1905 Victorian Arts and Crafts bed and breakfast in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, steps from the Inner Harbour. The property is chef-owned and operated by culinary instructor Vanessa von Schellwitz, whose elaborate gourmet breakfasts are the centrepiece of the stay. Two themed guest rooms — including a family suite sleeping up to five — feature antique clawfoot baths and private semi-entrances that keep guests out of the family living areas.
